Meta.Repo: github.com/LeighAtkins/threeWood improve/looks-perf-gameplay-ps1-retro https://threewood.vercel.app npm install && npm run dev (opens http://localhost:3000) Make ThreeWood PLAYABLE on a smartphone web browser (touch). CurrentState.Headline: It loads and builds. It is NOT yet touch-playable — input is keyboard+mouse only.

WhatWorks.Item: Live on Vercel (verified 200s on index/JS/sfx). Build is clean on Linux runner.
Deterministic seeded course generator with archetype grammar + fairness fitness (src/course/holeDesigner.js).
Club bag, lie penalties, instanced trees, multi-hole rounds, strict StateMachine.
White hole cup + sink animation, hole-facing camera, 2D minimap with shot-arc preview.
Title-screen rebrand to elevated low-poly (golden-hour gradient, low-poly ball emblem).

Block.Symptom: NO touch input anywhere in the codebase. Phones cannot aim, swing, or adjust loft.
Block.Evidence: grep for touchstart/touchmove/touchend/pointerdown returns ZERO hits across main.js, src/*.js, src/core/, src/course/.
Block.CurrentInput: - Aim: mouse-drag via window 'mousemove' delta -> game.js:570 cameraController.rotateAim(). - Swing: window 'mousedown'/'mouseup' -> game.js:591/596 -> the 3-click meter. - Loft: window 'wheel' -> game.js:603. - Club cycle / spin selector: keyboard (arrow keys, S).
Block.Fix: See MobileInput plan below. Prefer Pointer Events (one path for mouse+touch+pen).

Block.Symptom: Uncapped devicePixelRatio in main.js (title renderer) — retina phones render the title screen at full DPR, wasting fill-rate.
Block.Fix: Cap both renderers at ~2 (or 1.5 for the title). Tune for 60fps on mid Android.

Block.Symptom: No mobile viewport meta consideration beyond the default; no orientation guidance; HUD uses fixed px sizes that crowd small screens.
Block.Evidence: index.html has only the standard viewport meta. HUD elements are position:absolute with px sizes (src/ui.js).
Block.Fix: Encourage landscape; scale HUD to viewport; ensure controls sit in thumb zones (see HUDLayout).

Block.Symptom: The integrated overhaul has NEVER been playtested in a browser. Runtime bugs are likely and unknown.
Block.Fix: Before redesigning: open the LiveURL (or localhost), play one hole end-to-end, file real bugs. Don't polish a broken core.

Verification.Goal: Establish that the current build actually plays, so your work starts from truth not assumption.
Verification.Step: 1. npm run dev, open http://localhost:3000 on desktop. Set window.DEBUG=true in console.
2. Play one full hole: title -> aim (camera faces hole) -> 3-click swing -> watch flight -> land -> roll -> sink.
3. Open Chrome DevTools device toolbar (Ctrl+Shift+M) -> pick a phone -> reload. Note what breaks (this is your mobile baseline).
4. Check console for: embedded-ball warnings, NaN heights, off-screen camera, mesh-disposal leaks across holes.
5. ONLY after the desktop loop is confirmed solid, start the mobile work. Fix core bugs first, they compound on weak hardware.

MobileInput.Principle: Use Pointer Events (pointerdown/move/up/cancel), not separate mouse+touch handlers. One codepath, works for mouse, touch, and pen. Touch fires mouse events too but unreliably during drags — don't rely on the compatibility layer.

Interaction.name: aim
Interaction.Mobile: - One-finger drag anywhere on the 3D view rotates aim (horizontal drag = yaw). - Show an on-screen aim hint / directional cue so the player knows they're aiming. - Keep camera facing the hole as the default (faceHole already does this).

Interaction.name: swing
Interaction.Today: window 'mousedown'/'mouseup' drive the 3-click meter: click1 start power, click2 lock power, click3 strike [game.js:591/596 -> startSwing/swingClick].
Interaction.Mobile: - A dedicated SWING button (large, thumb-reachable, bottom-right) advances the 3-click phases. - Tap 1: start power climb. Tap 2: lock power (marker sweeps back). Tap 3: strike at the line. - The swing meter UI must be readable on a phone (src/ui.js updateSwingMeter) — widen it, make the strike line obvious. - This is the heart of the game; get the timing feel right on touch latency.

Interaction.name: loft-and-club
Interaction.Today: Wheel = loft trim [game.js:603]; arrow keys cycle club/variant.
Interaction.Mobile: - Loft: a vertical slider OR +/- buttons near the swing button. (Clubs now own base loft; this is fine trim.) - Club/variant: small cycle buttons (next/prev club) in a thumb zone, or a swipe gesture on a club chip. - Show current club + estimated distance prominently (clubs.estimateDistance exists).

LayoutPriorities.Item: Left thumb: aim drag (whole left 3D area) + club cycle.
Top bar: hole #, par, strokes, distance-to-pin, lie.
Corner: minimap (existing src/minimap.js) — keep it, scale to viewport.
Encourage LANDSCAPE orientation (CSS + a rotate-device prompt in portrait). The 3D view needs width.

DesignAnd3D.Direction: The art direction is currently "elevated stylized low-poly" in INTENT but inconsistent in EXECUTION — some flat-shaded terrain, a gradient sky, fog, but mixed materials and no scene dressing beyond trees+bridge. Your job: make it look deliberate and beautiful at a glance, on a phone screen, at distance.

Workstream.name: Materials & Lighting
Workstream.Task: Audit every material for consistency: flat shading everywhere, a single warm palette, fog color matched to horizon (already started in styles.css/game.js initSky).
Tune the sun: harder key light, soft fill, contact shadows that read on a small screen. Avoid high-frequency shadow aliasing on mobile.
Consider a baked-style ambient look (hemisphere light + low-cost specular) instead of heavy PBR — mobile fill-rate is precious.

Workstream.name: Scene Dressing
Workstream.goal: a world, not a math plane
Workstream.Task: Beyond trees: tall fescue rough, wildflowers/ground clutter near fairways, reeds at water edges, distant low-poly hills/skyline for depth (cheap, far-LOD billboards or low-geo).
Make hazards read instantly: water sparkle/animation, sand color contrast, bunker lips.
The flag + cup are the focal point of every hole — make them pop (the white cup is a good start; ensure it's visible from the tee at distance).

Workstream.name: Camera & Framing
Workstream.goal: golf-broadcast feel on a small screen
Workstream.Task: The hole-facing aim cam exists — refine framing so the line, landing zone, and hazard are all visible from the tee (readability is a design pillar).
Add a dedicated PUTT cam (top-down or low angle on the green) — putting is half the feel and currently shares the full-swing camera.
Ball-flight chase cam with optional slow-mo at apex for satisfying shots.
Keep camera transitions smooth and brief; long transitions feel bad on mobile.

Workstream.name: Juice
Workstream.Task: Ball compression on strike, motion trail on long shots, divot/splash particles, satisfying cup-drop.
Audio is rich (public/sfx/) — wire strike grade -> sound choice (the AudioManager already maps by power).
Haptic feedback (navigator.vibrate) on strike/cup on supported phones — a small touch that sells mobile.

MobilePerformanceBudget.Item: Target 60fps on a mid Android phone in landscape. Profile early, profile often.
Cap pixel ratio ~2, minimize draw calls (trees already use InstancedMesh — extend that pattern to clutter).
Frustum + distance culling; the current "render everything always" won't scale to 18 holes.
Shadows are the usual mobile killer — consider a single low-res directional shadow map, or fake contact shadows under the ball.

Architecture.Principle: Keep src/core/ and src/course/ PURE (no THREE, no DOM, no timers). They are testable data+functions. Touch/DOM code belongs in game.js/ui.js or a new src/input.js / src/mobileUI.js.
The seeded rng (src/core/rng.js) is the source of truth. No Math.random() in generation/physics.
Use the StateMachine (src/core/states.js), not ad-hoc string states.
The 3-click swing model (src/core/swing.js) is sound — don't rewrite it, wire touch input TO it (startSwing/swingClick/swingStep).
Architecture.GodObjectWarning: game.js is large. As you add mobile/input code, extract an InputController and a MobileHUD controller rather than growing game.js further.

Execution.Phase: Run Verification. Fix any core runtime bugs found. A broken desktop loop will be a broken mobile loop.
New src/input.js (Pointer Events) wrapping aim-drag, swing-tap, loft, club-cycle. Wire to existing cameraController.rotateAim + startSwing/swingClick. Keep mouse working (Pointer Events cover both).
Thumb-zoned controls (src/mobileUI.js or extend ui.js): big SWING button, loft +-, club cycle, landscape prompt. Scale minimap to viewport.
Cap DPR, profile, cull, simplify shadows. Hit 60fps on a mid phone.
Materials/lighting cohesion, scene dressing, camera framing, juice. This is where the 10/10 happens.

AntiGoals.Item: Do NOT rewrite the swing model, course generator, rng, clubs, or states — they are complete. Wire input to them.
Do NOT add a second input system alongside the mouse one — use Pointer Events to UNIFY mouse+touch+pen in one path.
Do NOT pursue photorealism — the stylized identity is the whole point. Optimize for readability + feel + mobile perf.
Do NOT trust desktop or emulator for mobile correctness — test on a real phone before declaring done.
Do NOT ship shadows/materials that look great on desktop but drop a phone to 20fps.

Handoff.FirstAction: Run Verification (P0). The live build is untested in-browser; establish what actually works before touching input or art. Report the bugs you find — they're the real starting point.
